notes.title: AVAILABLE NOW ON STEAM!!!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45529833/978c120518508a76280762efff72ec1bbf2daa06.png[/img]

[h3]SERRE IS FINALLY OUT ON STEAM!!!![/h3]

I made this game all the way back in 2017 for a game jam. Over the years people have asked me to put it on Steam, so they could more easily share it with their friends. That time has come. [b]Thank you for your support all these years.[/b]

This game is short, and it is sweet, and I hope you have a lovely time with it! [b]Please leave a review if you did[/b], it would make my day!!!

[b]The Artbook and Soundtrack are available as DLC, too![/b] And they're even all in a bundle, so you can buy them all for 15% off! I hope you like them!

See you soon <3

-Adrienne

notes.title: Adorable lesbian VN has dropped!!! (again)
notes.notes:
The Steam page for Serre, the cute lesbian visual novel about a human and an alien drinking tea together, is LIVE!!! And will be released THIS MONTH!!!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45529833/8c8ce768b05b2d3e58c8af14d18cf3bc8e8e7fbe.png[/img]

Hi. I'm Adrienne. You may know me for such video game hits like "In Stars and Time" and "START AGAIN: a prologue". But before them, [b]did you know Serre was my very first video game?[/b]

That's right! Serre was my first game, and also my first collaboration with In Stars and Time's composer, Studio Thumpy Puppy! That was in (checks) 2017?!?!? That was 8 years ago?!?!? Ok now that's bonkers. I thought it was 5, maybe.

Anyway, Serre was first released as a game jam entry for the Yuri Game Jam! It was released on [url=https://insertdisc5.itch.io/serre]itch.io[/url], and now, finally, it is here on Steam. WOW!!!

[b]🐝 "But, Adrienne! How different is this Steam version from the itch.io one?!?"[/b]
Not even a little bit.
Well. Serre is getting a long overdue SPANISH TRANSLATION at rerelease! So that's new!!! But it'll be on itch.io too. So there's no difference. EXCEPT YOU CAN PLAY IT ON STEAM NOW!!!! WOW!!! THE FUTURE IS HERE

Enough talking! Serre will be releasing before the end of the month (March 2025), and will also have the artbook and the soundtrack (!!!) as DLC. AND they'll be in a bundle so you can save some money. WOW!!!! Amazing. Clap clap clap

Please wishlist Serre, if you already played it, or if you haven't and it sounds interesting! I think it would be so funny if this 8yo game got 10000000 wishlists at release. K Thanks Bye Love U
